tools.name: verify_pin
tools.description: Verify the member's spoken PIN. MUST succeed before any other tool is used. Ask the member to say their PIN, then call this with the digits.

pin.description: The PIN digits the member spoke, digits only, e.g. "1234".

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Get the member's available balance and safe-to-spend amount. Call only after verify_pin succeeded.

tools.name: get_upcoming_bills
tools.description: List the member's upcoming bills, whether each is covered, and their next income. Call only after verify_pin succeeded.

tools.name: get_recent_transactions
tools.description: List the member's recent transactions, non-pending first. Pass the returned transaction_id to flag_transaction for a charge the member doesn't recognize.

tools.name: check_affordability
tools.description: Check whether the member can afford a proposed purchase before the next income, without touching their safety cushion.

amount_dollars.description: The amount in dollars the member asked about, e.g. 60 for sixty dollars.

tools.name: get_budgets
tools.description: List the member's budget categories with the monthly limit, how much they've spent so far this month, how much is left (or how much they're over by), the percent used, and their pace (under, on_track, over, or exceeded).

tools.name: propose_change
tools.description: Start a member-requested change (budget, reminders, quiet hours, alert rules, safety buffer, trusted contact). Read the returned summary back and never apply anything until the member clearly says yes, then call confirm_change.

change_type.description: Which kind of change the member wants.

payload.description: Shape depends on change_type. budget_update: { "category": "groceries", "monthlyLimitCents": 30000 } (monthlyLimitCents in cents). reminder_mode_update: { "reminderMode": "call" | "sms" | "off" }. quiet_hours_update: { "start": "20:00", "end": "09:00" } (24-hour HH:MM). alert_rule_toggle: { "type": "shortfall" | "bill_due_unfunded" | "unusual_txn" | "deposit_arrived", "enabled": true }. safety_buffer_update: { "safetyBufferCents": 10000 }. trusted_contact_update: { "name": "Maria", "phoneE164": "+14125550123", "relationship": "daughter" }.

tools.name: confirm_change
tools.description: Confirm a change previously proposed with propose_change. Call ONLY after the member unambiguously said yes.

confirmation_id.description: The confirmation_id returned by propose_change, verbatim.

tools.name: flag_transaction
tools.description: Flag a transaction the member reports as unrecognized, notify their family, and warn them about scams. Use the transaction_id from get_recent_transactions.

transaction_id.description: The transaction_id from get_recent_transactions for the charge the member doesn't recognize.
